query:
SELECT event.owner_id = $2 AS "is_owner!"
            FROM calendar_events event
            WHERE event.id = $1
              AND (
                  event.owner_id = $2
                  OR EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM macro_user_links link
                      WHERE link.link_id = event.source_link_id
                        AND link.primary_macro_id = $2
                  )
              )
